name: Ha Giang City Center
tagline: The functional launch pad along the Lo river
description: The provincial capital hugs the Lo river and serves as the practical base where most travellers arrive, gear up, and start the loop. It is a working town rather than a scenic one, with hostels, motorbike rental outfits, easy-rider operators, markets, and simple eateries all within easy reach.
bestFor: Arriving, organising the loop, and stocking up
pros: Widest choice of hostels, rentals, and tour operators
Best wifi and services in the province
cons: The town itself is unremarkable to look at
Little to do once you are organised

name: Quan Ba and the Heaven Gate
tagline: First mountain pass north of the city
description: Heading north on the loop, the road climbs to the Quan Ba Heaven Gate, a viewpoint over the famous Twin Mountains and terraced valleys. This is where the scenery first opens up dramatically, making it a popular early stop, photo pause, and gateway into the higher Dong Van plateau beyond.
vibe: Scenic first taste of the loop
bestFor: Viewpoints, photo stops, and easing into the ride
pros: Stunning Twin Mountains and valley views
Marks the real start of the scenery
cons: A stop rather than a base

name: Dong Van Old Town
tagline: Historic loop overnight on the karst plateau
description: Deep in the Dong Van Karst Plateau Geopark, Dong Van has a small old quarter of centuries-old houses, a lively Sunday market, and a cluster of homestays and cafes. It is a favourite overnight stop on the loop, sitting near the Chinese border and the road to the Ma Pi Leng Pass.
bestFor: Loop overnights, markets, and old-town character
pros: Historic old quarter and vibrant Sunday market

name: Meo Vac
tagline: Quiet base beneath the Ma Pi Leng Pass
description: Reached by crossing the spectacular Ma Pi Leng Pass above the Nho Que river gorge, Meo Vac is a smaller, quieter town ringed by dramatic peaks. Famous for its bustling Sunday livestock market and Hmong culture, it makes a peaceful loop overnight and a launch point for Nho Que boat trips.
bestFor: Ma Pi Leng access, Nho Que gorge, and hill-tribe markets
pros: Right below the iconic Ma Pi Leng Pass
Famous Sunday market and Hmong culture
